text: This report presents a work plan for the review of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 546, Licensing of Vehicles-for-Hire. A report on the results of the review is expected at the Licensing and Standards Committee in the second quarter of 2019. Consultations with stakeholders and the public are scheduled for the third and fourth quarter of 2018. In May 2016, Toronto City Council adopted a series of recommendations to establish new regulations for the vehicles-for-hire industry. The new Vehicles-for-Hire By-law regulates taxicabs, limousines, and private transportation companies, like Uber and Lyft, to ensure public safety, consumer protection, and equitable access to accessible vehicles. Since May 2016, staff have focussed on implementing the new regulations.
